title: 第1924章 都怪先帝死得太早第1923章 璐王府奔丧
content_zh:
“母亲莫恼！等儿子继承爵位后，王府依旧是母亲做主。”老大宋成霖急忙安慰宋安许。
宋安许摆摆手，“此事跟你没关系。皇帝不待见我，又不是一天两天的事。今日结果，早有预料，也能接受。只是我没想到，他当真如此小气。”
听这意思，宋安许跟元鼎帝之间，貌似有过节。
陈观楼好奇问道：“你得罪过他？”
宋安许冷哼一声，“当年我进京，他们母子刻意结交。我一个藩王之女，岂敢牵扯进夺嫡之争。先帝非弄死我不可。我果断拒绝了他们母子的拉拢。或许是因为此事，皇帝一直记恨。如今终于叫他逮着机会报复我。”
原来还有这回事。
陈观楼说道：“皇帝本就是心胸狭窄之辈，只记仇不记恩。不必为了他动怒。”
“我就是看不起他，一个大男人，小气吧啦，斤斤计较。”在自家府邸，又有陈观楼在，宋安许什么话都敢说。
保证没人偷听。
就算王府有锦衣卫的暗探，甚至是城门军的暗探，她自信，无人能在不惊动陈观楼的前提下窥探他们的谈话。
璐王妃轻咳一声，“事已至此，唯有接受。皇帝的态度你们都看见了，从今以后，都谨慎些。成霖，你继承了王爵，更要严格要求自己，莫要胡闹。但也不能太正经，太过上进。其中分寸，你要好好把握。”
“孙儿谨记祖母教诲。”
“小楼好不容易来一趟，先去祭拜王爷。晚些时候一起用饭。”
“晚辈听从王妃安排。”
天气热，璐王的棺椁已经转移到王府家庙。王府内只设了灵牌祭拜。
陈观楼跟着宋安许，给璐王烧了一炷香。
“王爷临终前，没有为难你吧。”他还有点担心。
“他怎会为难我。我给他生了两个聪明懂事的孙子，随着孩子们一天天长大，他越发满意。当初一力主张让成霖继承王爵也是他。他说我没机会继承王爵，宫里头不会答应，真让他说中了。”
宋安许有些许不满，还有委屈。
陈观楼搂着她的肩，“都怪先帝死得太早。”

宋安许控制不住，噗嗤一声，笑了起来。
“是啊，先帝死得太早。当今陛下是个小心眼的，我一个女人他都容不下。”
“别气！离着老大及冠还有好几年，你虽无王爷之名，却有王爷之权。也不算亏！”
“终究少了个名头，正所谓名正言顺。哎……”宋安许也很无奈，身为女子，终究限制了她的抱负。
死皇帝，心眼小得跟针尖似的。
陈观楼赶紧转移话题，“你将两个孩子教育得很好。一开始我还担心两小子跟我有隔阂，只怕不会认我。”
“他们当然会认你。我告诉他们，他们的爹很厉害，天赋卓绝的九品武者，而且容貌出众，品性又好。不是外面那起子成日惦记着王府的小人。”
陈观楼哈哈大笑起来，“你真这么说？”
宋安许白了他一眼，“你以为我说谎？”
“当然没有。我只是没想到，你会在孩子面前这么夸我。”
content_en:
"Don't be upset, mother! After your son inherits the title, the mother will still make the decision in the palace." The eldest son, Song Chenglin, hurriedly comforted Song Anxu.
Song Anxu waved his hand, "This matter has nothing to do with you. The emperor doesn't want to see me, and it doesn't happen in a day or two. Today's results were already expected and acceptable. But I didn't expect that he would be so stingy."
Judging from this, there seems to be some dispute between Song Anxu and Emperor Yuanding.
Chen Guanlou asked curiously: "Have you ever offended him?"
Song Anxu snorted coldly, "When I came to the capital, their mother and son deliberately made friends. As the daughter of a vassal king, how dare I get involved in the fight for the right to inherit the throne. The late emperor had to kill me. I decisively refused their mother and son's solicitation. Perhaps because of this, the emperor has always held a grudge. Now he finally asked him to seize the opportunity to retaliate against me."
It turns out there is such a thing.
Chen Guanlou said: "The emperor is a narrow-minded person. He only holds grudges but not gratitude. There is no need to be angry because of him."
"I just look down on him. He's a grown man. He's stingy and cares about everything." In his own mansion, with Chen Guanlou around, Song Anxu dared to say anything.
Make sure no one eavesdrops.
Even if there were spies from the Royal Guards in the palace, or even spies from the City Gate Army, she was confident that no one could spy on their conversation without alerting Chen Guanlou.
Princess Lu coughed lightly and said, "The situation has come to this, so we can only accept it. You have all seen the emperor's attitude. From now on, be more cautious. Cheng Lin, you have inherited the title of king, and you must strictly demand yourself and don't mess around. But you can't be too serious or too motivated. You have to grasp the appropriateness."
"My grandson will remember his grandmother's teachings."
"It's not easy for me to come here, Xiaolou. I'm going to pay homage to the prince first. Let's have dinner together later."
"Junior, please follow the princess's arrangements."
The weather is hot, and King Lu's coffin has been moved to the Wangfu family temple. There are only spiritual tablets for worship in the palace.
Chen Guanlou followed Song Anxu and burned a stick of incense for King Lu.
"Prince, before he died, he didn't make things difficult for you." He was still a little worried.
"How could he embarrass me? I gave him two smart and sensible grandsons. As the children grew up day by day, he became more and more satisfied. It was he who advocated for Cheng Lin to inherit the prince title. He said that I had no chance to inherit the prince title and the palace would not agree. He was right."
Song Anxu was a little dissatisfied and aggrieved.
Chen Guanlou put his arm around her shoulders and said, "It's all because the late emperor died too early."
Song Anxu couldn't control it and burst into laughter.
"Yes, the late emperor died too early. Your Majesty is very narrow-minded now. He can't tolerate even one of my women."
"Don't be angry! It's still several years before you become the eldest brother and crown prince. Although you don't have the name of a prince, you have the power of a prince. It's not a loss!"
"After all, a name is missing. As the saying goes, the name is justified. Alas..." Song Anxu was also helpless. As a woman, her ambitions were limited after all.
The dead emperor is as narrow-minded as a needle.
Chen Guanlou quickly changed the subject, "You have taught your two children well. At first, I was worried that there was a gap between the two boys and me, and I was afraid that they would not recognize me."
"Of course they will recognize you. I told them that their father is very powerful, a talented ninth-grade warrior with outstanding appearance and good character. He is not the villain outside who is always thinking about the palace."
Chen Guanlou burst out laughing, "Did you really say that?"
Song Anxu rolled her eyes at him, "Do you think I lied?"
"Of course not. I just didn't expect you to praise me so much in front of your children."
